"''Except for greed.|[[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]]|''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''}} The '''InterGalactic Banking Clan''' (also known as the '''InterGalactic Bank Clan''', '''Galactic Banking Clan''', '''Banking Clan''', or the '''IG Banking Clan''' and often abbreviated to '''IGBC''' or '''IBC''') was one of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] most powerful and influential commerce guilds in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was a union of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst's]] ruling [[Council of Banking Clans]] and several other banking powers. The clan was based at the command tower on Muunilinst. The [[Tonith family]] was one of the more powerful clans that oversaw the IBC. The [[Iotran Guard/Legends|Iotran Guard]] served as a military division of the Clan. Additionally, the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] was heavily involved with the Banking Clan since at least [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous's]] time, secretly manipulating the organization. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] was allied to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], but the Banking Clan itself remained officially neutral. However, the IGBC fought against the Republic during the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], at an early stage of the war. After a scandal involving new IGBC leader [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]], the entire organization was placed under the jurisdiction of the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office]] of the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], effectively nationalizing the banks. ==Organization== {{Quote|The safety of our clients' investment is always our paramount concern.|IBC Chairman San Hill.|}} The InterGalactic Banking Clan operated by facilitating the movement of incredible amounts of credits, data, and other forms of currency that flowed through the galaxy. This ancient institution ventures were controlled by key representatives of the old banking families. It extended its financial services to many of the major commercial guilds in the galaxy.''{{DB|organization|igbc|InterGalactic Banking Clan}}'' The IBC had their own data-server that allowed clients to access to the banking clan's datacom-net.{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|business/13228_2.html|Datanet Propaganda the Real Deal?}} Accompanying IBC staff were soldiers from [[Iotra]] that wore garish body armor and carried ceremonial weapons. Whilst showing a façade of a consumer friendly organization, the IGBC maintained a sizable [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and [[Iotran/Legends|Iotran]] military known as the [[Collections and Security Division/Legends|Collections and Security Division]]. Amongst their combat automata included the hoop-wheeled [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire droids]] that were used exclusively by the Banking Clan's Collections and Security division{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|business/1359_1.html|IBC Denies Arming Separatists}} and being the property of IBC executives.{{InsiderCite|65|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:2:14 Edition}} These hoop-wheeled droids made loan agreements proceed to a chillingly expedient pace. Members of the IBC included financiers, accounts and lawyers that were dressed in signatory [[Palo fiduciary garb]] with formfitting green trousers and boots, round-collared green tunics and flare-shouldered green cloaks. Within the hierarchy of the Banking Clan, leading positions included the Muunilinst [[High Officer]], the Administrator the treasure world of Mygeeto, the Director of the Treasury Branch and the Vice-Chair of Communications, with the Chairman of the Banking Clan at the top of the corporate hierarchy. The [[Muunilinst Banking Clan/Legends|Muunilinst Banking Clan]] served as a sub-division. ==History== ===Origin=== [[File:SanHill-FF132.png|thumb|left|[[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]], [[Chairman/Legends|chairman]] of the InterGalactic Banking Clan during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]] {{Quote|The IBC will be essential in financing the war we will slowly foment. We will need the Banking Clan to finance the manufacturers of weapons and to sustain an alternative economy for the eventual enemies of the Republic.|Darth Plagueis to his apprentice, Darth Sidious|}} The founding of the IGBC dated back to the creation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] where it dictated the flow of wealth between the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the Banking Clan that funded governments, supported settlements and bankrolled countless commerce guilds, trade corporations and shipping cartels. In [[3643 BBY]],{{TOR_dates|1}} during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a galactic hero recovered a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] written in a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Muun (language)/Legends|dialect]] and dispatched a companion to [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] to find someone to decipher it. The companion successfully discovered the datapad was a digital copy of the IGBC's original articles of incorporation which the IGBC head was eager to add to their archives.{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Muun Documents}} In that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a group of [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] planned a heist on an IGBC vault but required another skilled member to pull off the job. A galactic hero's companion filled the role and though the heist was executed according to plan, turmoil ensued when the loot was divided up and the companion was the sole member left alive after a firefight broke out among the robbers.{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Bank Error}} Sometime prior, the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Andronikos Revel]] had been an [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] on Muunilinst when he pulled a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on the head of the IGBC and robbed the clan of a few million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].{{TORcite|type=conversation|[[Andronikos Revel]]|Welcome Aboard}} At some point, the Banking Clan established [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]] as one of its key worlds that rested in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] boundaries.{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_1.html|Senator Moe Killed in Blast}} During the [[New Sith Wars]] era, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Qordis]] embezzled funds from the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] in order to pay for his avarice and kept them in an anonymous account used by the InterGalactic Banking Clan where he stored these funds.''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'' The IGBC was an important part of the Sith's [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]]; [[Caar Damask]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Banking Clan official who rose to become Chairman, owed his ascension through the ranks to the covert patronage of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]]. In exchange, Damask allowed Tenebrous to influence the conception of his son, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], and subsequently take him as his Sith apprentice, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. Plagueis would later use the Clan to finance much of the Plan, including the creation of the secret [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Army]] on Kamino, weapons manufacturers for both sides and to ensure the eventual [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|secession movement]] could maintain an alternative economy. Damask also tutored his [[Larsh Hill|friend's]] son [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] in preparation for his accession to the Chairmanship of the Clan. At some point, a vast region of the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] became an economic playground divided between the IBC and the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]]. It was known to have signed lucrative money-lending programs to large economic bodies such as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. ===Separatist Crisis=== {{Quote|These systems leave the Republic and are out on their own in the galaxy for the first time. They get seduced by an introductory one-to-one exchange rate and the chance to put their own names on money. ''[…]'' The InterGalactic Banking Clan doesn't care if these credits go up or down. If enough systems leave the Republic, they'll be getting a percentage of every transaction in the galaxy.|[[Argee Beck]]|''{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|business/13314_1.html|Currency Upheavals Deliver Profits to IBC}}''}} During the years of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the IBC data-server spread [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] propaganda when clients accessed the datacom-net where messages of secession and Senate reform were stated with the signature of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. This led to [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]] sending skilled [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] to examine the server and purge the system. The [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] dismissed the propanda as a hoax whilst the Banking Clan assured investors that their systems were secure.{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|business/13228_2.html|Datanet Propaganda the Real Deal?}} In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the IGBC experienced its 18th straight quarter with increasing profits. It was creating new currencies at a rate of twenty per day, with the [[InterGalactic Currency Exchange System]] managing the currency. [[Vice-Chair of Communications]] [[Lo Vapeet]] even went as far to offer the next 500 registrants who were approved currencies a deluxe six-slot [[therma-slice]]. This plan helped the IGBC with their new partners in finance for the upcoming Clone Wars. In this time, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] intended to meet with representatives of the IBC in order to discuss possible funding options for a proposed [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] initiative. However, his [[Speeder/Legends|speeder's]] power plant overloaded and exploded which killed the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]]. The Banking Clan's representatives had not announced the cost of damages nor the accumulated interest caused by the accident. Allegations later came of the IBC arming the Separatists after a [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] destined for [[Praesitlyn/Legends|Praesitlyn]] was detained by [[Eriadu Customs and Immigration|Eriadu Customs]] that contained 144 Hailfire droids. Banking Clan spokesbeings denied any involvement or knowledge of the intercepted shipment and claimed that the droids were stolen equipment. At an unknown point during the Separatist Crisis, Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] secretly opened several accounts in which he secretly subverted whole-planetary funds to be used at a later point, tax-free and account-free, so that several corporations affiliated with the IGBC (including [[Yarrow Industries]]) could profit. In exchange of that, the IGBC supported the Chancellor in the Galactic Senate in a moment when the not-yet-Emperor still needed that support. To carry out this project, Palpatine secretly expended billions of credits from several planets. The whole plot was discovered by journalist [[Keets Freely]], but he was unable to publish it.''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]'' The InterGalactic Banking Clan benefited greatly from the economic turbulence that accompanied the Separatist movement. This was because it became the most prominent lending institution that many new independent worlds turned to for economic assistance. ===Clone Wars=== {{Quote|The InterGalactic Banking Clan will support you wholeheartedly, Count Dooku. But only in a nonexclusive arrangement.|Chairman San Hill at Geonosis.|[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]}} During the Clone Wars, the IGBC supplied its security forces including its battle droids to the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Among its battle droids were the [[IG lancer droid/Legends|IG lancer combat droids]], which were more advanced than the more common [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid]] [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. These droids had actually been developed by [[Phlut Design Systems/Legends|Phlut Design Systems]], a Muunilinst-based weapons development firm that had taken out a large capital investment loan from the IGBC. PDS found itself unable to repay the IGBC, and, in response, the IGBC seized the company's assets, adding the IG lancer droids to the military forces of the CIS. The IGBC sold the company's further plans for the [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] to [[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]]. The IGBC later commissioned Holowan Mechanicals to manufacture [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] elite [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]]. This business entity was noted to have allied itself with the growing Separatist movement in the galaxy. The IBC Chairman, San Hill, personally committed his forces to the Confederacy of Independent Systems in a non-exclusive pact that allowed the Banking Clan to profit from both ends of the war by serving the Republic as well as the Separatists. During this time, a Republic inspection team was sent to discover the origins of the Hailfire droids captured on Geonosis and believing them to be from the IBC Arcology manufacturing plants. The highest ranks of the InterGalactic Banking Clan were involved in eight months of diplomatic dialogue over the Republic posting military forces within the neutral territories of Aargau. This came after the disappearance of the Republic inspection team on the world and saw Republic [[Diplomat/Legends|Diplomat]] [[Gaddatha In'Kro]] attempt to relieve tensions by pointing to IBC ties to the Separatist Alliance. During the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], Banking Clan droids were attacked by Republic forces. [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] would later lead the IGBC's new IG lancer droids. Durge was defeated, however, and San Hill and his advisors were captured. San Hill would later be given the opportunity to escape Republic captivity. [[File:BankingClanIntRate-POP.png|thumb|250px|[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] reviews the high interest rate the IGBC will charge after deregulation of the banks]] In the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the IGBC's interests were represented by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]], a human from the planet [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]], though his dealings with [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] and their plot to construct droid factories for the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] were exposed. Despite this the Clan was tolerated by the Republic throughout the war. It retained representation in the Senate as the Clan was too important to the Republic economy to be prosecuted, and like the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] it continued to argue that it was merely conducting business with both sides in a neutral manner.{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}} The Galactic Senate passed legislation to de-regulate the Banking Clan in order to open up new lines of credit to fund an expansion of the military.{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}} At some point after the Battle of Muunilinst, the IGBC headquarters were moved to [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]], though the banks remained under the authority of the Muun government.{{TCW|The Rise of Clovis}} Rush Clovis and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] uncovered evidence of corruption within the Clan, which forced the Republic and the Separatists to conduct a temporary truce so as to appoint new leadership. Rush Clovis was chosen as the new head of the IGBC. However, Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who secretly endorsed Clovis' ascension, blackmailed him into levying debts against the Republic, leading to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|GAR]] to evict the droid army from Scipio. In the aftermath of Clovis's death during the battle, the banks were placed under the control of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine. Unbeknownst to everyone, this was all a Sith plot for Palpatine's alter-ego, Darth Sidious, to gain more political power for his eventual galactic takeover. It continued to back and profiteer both sides during the war. The IGBC also funded Grievous's reconstruction in exchange for his services as a collections agent. The same technology would later be used to save the life of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. ===Imperial Period=== Despite the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|death]] of Chairman Hill at [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], the InterGalactic Banking Clan escaped the fate of many of its co-conspirators and managed to survive into the Imperial era, becoming the creditor for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|restructured currency]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Riklon Tost]], captain of the Iotran Guard, served as a liaison between the New Order and the Muuns. His negotiations helped the IGBC placate the Emperor without surrendering any of the Banking Clan's real power.''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' Its continued existence was merely a matter of necessity, for the Empire did fear the potential of a galactic recession and allowed the IGBC to carry on in their day-to-day activities, though they controlled the economy and retained a level of control of Scipio and Muunilinst.''[[Endless Vigil]]'' [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]], which included a corps of administrative personnel, were placed to watch over the InterGalactic Banking Clan's activities.''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]'' Though the Empire kept a tight watch on the IGBC, the Clan never considered switching their support to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], feeling that they could credit ''both'' if it came to that. After the establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the IGBC did become the creditor of both governments. The IGBC continued to be under Imperial control until the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] was formed in [[138 ABY]]. ==Associations== ===Notable members=== *[[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]]:
